rv.q: Under the direction of Jeffrey Cass, this ensemble of 16, plus an amazing orchestra conducted by Phil Videckis, brings Schwartz’ fantasy to new life.

In what may be the finest, most polished production of this professional company’s thirteen years, they’re presenting a truly magical, captivating and heartfelt version of Stephen Schwartz’s beloved 1970’s pop/rock musical.
The hard working ensemble sang and danced their hearts out to the catchy songs of Stepehn Schwartz, giving the audience an entertaining night out.
BrightSide offers a fine introduction to this comic and touching musical, with outstanding singing and an inventive set.
This is a spectacular, not-to-be-missed, finale show for Brightside’s thirteenth season.

cn.t: BrightSide Theatre's "Pippin" earns strong praise as a polished, magical production that captures the heart of Schwartz's classic. Critics call it charming and captivating, possibly the company's finest work in thirteen years.
